_comment: Render sweep on the jscad modeling engine (sci push jscadui/render-jscad), 320s hang guard, all 1420 models the manifold sweep covers. 1206 render and 76 only echo or draw text. scale() by a zero or negative factor and $fn below three now render, which fixed 17 yapp-box examples, threads.scad and 8 openscad-tests; the % and # ghosts fixed 4 more and radials.scad renders. issue1672.scad is empty and test-view-variables.scad draws only text, as in OpenSCAD. PCB.scad sits at the memory limit and crashes or renders from run to run, so it is marked flaky, as are packing_circles.scad and heart_chain.scad on the 290s model budget.
